description: Sign in to Telegram, inspect bounded history, preview resolved messages, and send only under an owner-approved Saved-Messages-only policy.
configHelp: Install the pinned tg v0.11.0 release into the plugin-owned runtime directory with `node telegram-client/scripts/install-tg.cjs` from the codeterm-plugins checkout. Open the Telegram Client view, enter your own Telegram API ID and API hash from my.telegram.org, and start QR login. Agent verbs: `accounts`; `use <account-id>`; `chats`; `history <chat-id> [n]`; `health`; `logout`; `preview <chat-id> <text>`; `send <chat-id> [--key <idempotency-key>] <text>`. Sending is closed until the owner explicitly enables the Saved-Messages-only policy after reviewing the resolved preview. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB. API credentials are stored with host.secretSet and supplied in process environment, never arguments. The app_hash is also persisted by tg in its YAML config. On macOS sessions use the login Keychain; other platforms store a session file inside this plugin's private runtime directory.
